errors.FFMPEG_KILLED: The GPU encoder ({{encoder}}) stopped after {{duration}} without an error message (exit code {{exitCode}}). Another program may have stopped ffmpeg, but a GPU encoder failure is also possible. Retry this file.
errors.FFMPEG_KILLED_fallback_failed: The GPU encoder ({{encoder}}) stopped after {{duration}} without an error message (exit code {{exitCode}}), and the CPU encoder ({{fallback}}) failed too. Another program may have stopped ffmpeg, but a GPU encoder failure is also possible. Retry this file. If it fails again, set Settings › Encoding › Encoder to “Processor first”.
errors.FFMPEG_KILLED_no_cpu_encoder: The GPU encoder ({{encoder}}) stopped after {{duration}} without an error message (exit code {{exitCode}}), and no CPU encoder works with this ffmpeg to take over. Another program may have stopped ffmpeg, but a GPU encoder failure is also possible. Retry, or use an ffmpeg that includes libx264.
errors.FFMPEG_KILLED_hevc_gpu_only: The GPU encoder ({{encoder}}) stopped after {{duration}} without an error message (exit code {{exitCode}}). Another program may have stopped ffmpeg, but a GPU encoder failure is also possible. HEVC has no CPU fallback; retry, or switch to H.264 in the advanced encoding settings.

errors.ENCODER_FALLBACK_start_failed: The GPU encoder ({{from}}) failed to start for this file, even after several tries. squeezegram switched to the CPU encoder ({{to}}) for this file and will try the GPU again on the next one.
errors.ENCODER_FALLBACK_start_failed_again: The GPU encoder ({{from}}) failed to start again, on a second file in a row. squeezegram switched to the CPU encoder ({{to}}) and keeps using it until the app restarts.
errors.ENCODER_FALLBACK_suspected_kill: The GPU encoder ({{from}}) stopped after {{duration}} without an error message. Another program may have stopped ffmpeg, but a GPU encoder failure is also possible. squeezegram switched to the CPU encoder ({{to}}) for this file and will try the GPU again on the next one.
errors.ENCODER_FALLBACK_suspected_kill_gpu_off: The GPU encoder ({{from}}) stopped after {{duration}} without an error message. Another program may have stopped ffmpeg, but a GPU encoder failure is also possible. squeezegram switched to the CPU encoder ({{to}}) and keeps using it until the app restarts.

errors.TOO_MANY_FILES: This would add more than {{max}} files at once. Nothing was added. Add them in several parts.

errors.SIDECAR_CHECKSUM: The downloaded ffmpeg doesn't match the expected checksum, so it was not installed.

errors.SIDECAR_EXTRACT: The ffmpeg archive couldn't be extracted.

errors.SIDECAR_INVALID: This folder doesn't hold a working ffmpeg and ffprobe, so it was not used.

finder.search: Look for an ffmpeg already installed

finder.intro: Only known install folders and the folders of your PATH are checked, and every result is run once to confirm it works. Nothing is used until you choose it.
finder.none: No usable ffmpeg was found on this computer.
finder.pathNote: Found in your PATH. It is listed only: squeezegram never picks an ffmpeg from PATH by itself.

recommendation.candidate: Recommended: use the ffmpeg marked below.

finder.weakWarning: Only basic CPU encoders work with this ffmpeg.

reason.hw_qsv: Your PC has an Intel GPU: this ffmpeg drives it (Quick Sync).
reason.hw_amf: Your PC has an AMD GPU: this ffmpeg drives it.
reason.cpu_x264: It includes libx264, the best CPU fallback and the most accurate for size targets.
reason.no_working_encoder: No H.264 encoder works with it.
reason.license_gpl: GPL build, fine for local use.
reason.candidate_adds_x264: This ffmpeg includes libx264, which the download doesn't: a better CPU fallback and more accurate sizes.
reason.candidate_adds_hardware: This ffmpeg drives a hardware encoder ({{encoder}}) that the download can't use here.
reason.download_no_candidate: No ffmpeg was found on this computer, so the download is the simplest choice.

reason.download_hardware_assumed: The download isn't installed yet: its hardware support (NVENC, Quick Sync, AMF) is assumed from the pinned build.

caption.tooLong: Telegram refuses longer captions: the files would fail instead of being sent.

queue.startUnavailable: Nothing to process: add files, or approve or retry the ones that are waiting.
queue.pauseUnavailable: Nothing is running or waiting for its turn.
queue.running: Running: one file at a time. Pausing takes effect after the current file.
queue.idle: Ready: the files you add are processed automatically.
queue.paused: Paused: nothing is processed until you press Start.

empty.title: The queue is empty
empty.body: Drop files anywhere in the window, or browse for them above.

clear.unavailable: Nothing to clear: the queue is empty or only holds files being processed right now.
clear.title: Clear the queue?
clear.body: The files you clear leave the queue and their prepared copies are deleted. Your original files are never deleted. A file being processed right now is not touched.

all.label: Clear everything not running
all.hint_one: {{count}} file, including files waiting to be sent. They will not be sent.
all.hint_other: {{count}} files, including files waiting to be sent. They will not be sent.

clear.unconfirmed_one: {{count}} file is marked “Needs check”: it may already have reached Telegram. Clearing removes it without checking.
clear.unconfirmed_other: {{count}} files are marked “Needs check”: they may already have reached Telegram. Clearing removes them without checking.
clear.running_one: {{count}} file is still running and was kept.
clear.running_other: {{count}} files are still running and were kept.

encoding.intro: These choices replace the settings for this file only. You can change them until the file starts.
encoding.inactive: This file has custom choices, but they are ignored without Premium.
encoding.locked: Choose the codec, resolution and size of a single file with squeezegram Premium.

estimate.failed: The size cannot be estimated right now.
estimate.as_is: Sent as it is or repackaged, without re-encoding: about {{size}}.
estimate.too_small: This size is too small for the length of this video.
estimate.unknown: No estimate: the length of this video is unknown.
estimate.fallback: HEVC is not available on this computer: this file will be H.264.

duplicate.body: This file was already sent to this destination. It waits until you confirm.
duplicate.dialogBody: {{name}} was already sent to this destination. Sending it again posts a duplicate message.

watch.body: Found in a watched folder. Nothing is sent without your approval.

waiting.body: Telegram asked to slow down. Nothing was sent; it retries on its own at {{time}}.

interval.body: Waiting for this chat's minimum interval between sends. It goes out at {{time}}; other files go meanwhile.

unknown.body: The app stopped while this file was uploading. It may or may not have reached Telegram.
unknown.dialogBody: If the first upload did arrive, the chat gets {{name}} twice.
unknown.noCandidate: No matching message found in the chat.
unknown.candidatesTitle: Messages that may be this file

failed.keptHint: The prepared file is kept: retrying doesn't compress it again.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this file?
cancelDialog.body: The work done on {{name}}, including the prepared copy, is discarded. The original file is never touched.

history.title: History
history.description: Sent, failed and unconfirmed files, newest first.

clear.title: Clear the history?
clear.body: This deletes every line of the history, not only the ones shown. The app also uses it to warn you when a file was already sent to the same destination: once it is cleared, files you already sent can be sent again without any warning. The queue and your destinations are not affected.

settings.title: Settings
settings.invalid: Fix the highlighted fields to save.

license.title: License
license.hint: A license unlocks squeezegram Premium for the Telegram account it was bought for. It is checked on this computer, with no network request.
license.unavailable: The license status couldn't be read.

status.pending: A license is saved. Sign in to Telegram to check it: it applies once the account it was bought for is signed in.
status.otherAccount: The saved license is bound to another Telegram account. Sign in with the account it was bought for, or remove it.
status.invalid: The saved license can't be used. {{message}}

input.label: Paste your license
input.hint: The bot sends it in a message. It starts with SQZ1.

license.savedPending: License saved. Sign in to Telegram to check it.
license.buy: Buy a license from @squeezegram_bot on Telegram

remove.title: Remove the license?
remove.body: Premium features stop on this computer. Keep the bot's message: the same license can be activated again.

premium.label: Telegram Premium
premium.hint: “Detect from my account” uses the limit of the signed-in Telegram account: 4000 MB with Telegram Premium, 2000 MB without, or while signed out. A custom limit overrides it.
premium.currentUnavailable: The limit applied now could not be read.

custom.label: Custom limit (MB)
custom.hint: Overrides the Telegram Premium limit. Leave empty to use it.
custom.error: Enter a whole number of MB, greater than 0.

margin.label: Safety margin (%)
margin.hint: Compressed files aim this far under the limit. 3 % has proven reliable.

prefer.label: Encoder
prefer.hint: If the first kind fails its test, the other one is used. If the graphics card stops in the middle of a compression (a game or a screen recorder using it can cause this), the file is compressed again on the processor. If that keeps happening, choose “Processor first”: slower, but it leaves the graphics card alone.
prefer.gpuFailed: The graphics card encoder ({{encoder}}) stopped during a compression in this session. squeezegram uses the processor until the app restarts, then tries the graphics card again.

advanced.title: Advanced encoding
advanced.locked: Included with squeezegram Premium. Until then, compression uses the automatic values shown here.

resolution.label: Maximum resolution
resolution.hint: Larger videos are scaled down to this size; smaller ones are never enlarged. A higher resolution leaves fewer bits for each pixel under the upload limit.

audio.label: Audio bitrate
audio.hint: A higher bitrate sounds better and takes room from the picture under the upload limit.

codec.label: Video codec
codec.hint: HEVC keeps more detail at the same size, but it needs a graphics card that can encode it, and some Telegram apps do not play it inline. It only applies to a file that gets re-encoded.

preset.label: Encoder speed
preset.hint: Faster finishes sooner; higher quality takes longer for a better picture at the same size. Encoders without a speed setting ignore this.

target.label: Output size
target.hint: Fill the upload limit, or aim for a smaller file. A file never goes over the limit.
target.error: Enter a whole number of MB from 1 to 4000.

caps.title: Safety limits
caps.hint: These keep a single file from using up this computer's memory or time. Everyone gets the defaults shown; with Premium you can lower each one or raise it up to twice its default.
caps.errorWhole: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
caps.photo_wide_mpx: Largest photo with transparency or 16 bits (Mpx)
caps.stall_min: Stop an encode that stalls for (minutes)

watch.title: Watched folders
watch.hint: New photos and videos that appear in these folders are added to the queue as pending, including those that arrived while squeezegram was closed. Nothing is sent until you approve each one. Files already in a folder when you add it are left alone.
watch.locked: Included with squeezegram Premium. Folders listed here stay saved, but none is watched until then.

status.active: Watching: new files wait in the queue for your approval.
status.paused: Paused: new files are not added.
status.unreadable: Can't be read: the folder was moved, renamed or deleted, or its drive is offline. Choose it again or remove it.

network.title: Network
network.hint: Use a proxy if Telegram is blocked or slow where you are. Every connection to Telegram then goes through it.
network.secretHint: As given with the proxy, in hexadecimal or base64url.
network.secretSaved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
network.protected: The password or secret is stored encrypted for your Windows account and is never shown again.
network.testOk: The proxy works: Telegram answered in {{ms}} ms.

send.title: Pauses between sends
send.hint: A random pause in this range follows every send.
send.errorInteger: Enter a whole number of seconds, 0 or more.
send.errorOrder: The minimum can't be more than the maximum.

device.label: Device name
device.hint: Shown in Telegram under Settings > Devices. Leave it empty to use the name shown here. squeezegram gives it to Telegram when it starts: a new name applies after a restart, and Telegram may keep showing the previous one for a session already signed in until you sign in again.
device.error: Use at most 64 characters, on a single line.

apiIdentity.title: Advanced: your own API identity
apiIdentity.hint: squeezegram connects to Telegram with its own api_id. If you created one at my.telegram.org, you can use it instead.
apiIdentity.warning: Each identity keeps its own Telegram session on this computer. With your own api_id you sign in again the first time; going back to squeezegram's identity finds its session again. The change applies after squeezegram restarts.
apiIdentity.busy: Telegram is starting or signing out: wait a moment before changing the identity.
apiIdentity.product: squeezegram's own identity is in use.
apiIdentity.saved: Your api_id {{apiId}} is saved, with its api_hash (stored encrypted for your Windows account, never shown again).
apiIdentity.hashMissing: Your api_id {{apiId}} is saved, but its api_hash can't be read on this Windows account. Enter both again, or remove them.
apiIdentity.restart: Restart squeezegram to use this change.

apiId.label: api_id
apiId.error: Enter the api_id as a whole number, as shown on my.telegram.org.

apiHash.label: api_hash
apiHash.hint: 32 characters, digits and letters a to f. Stored encrypted for your Windows account and never shown again.
apiHash.error: The api_hash has 32 characters, digits and letters a to f.

remove.title: Go back to squeezegram's identity?
remove.body: Your api_id and api_hash are deleted from this computer. After the restart, squeezegram's identity and its session are used again.

caption.title: Default caption
caption.hint: Prefills the caption when you add files. Leave it empty for no caption.
caption.label: Caption template

strip.label: Remove location and camera data from photos
strip.hint: Photos sent without re-encoding (as files, for example) go out without their GPS position, camera serial numbers or editing history; their pixels and orientation are kept. Compliant MP4 videos lose their recorded location the same way. Videos sent without re-encoding also lose embedded cover images and attachments (MKV fonts included). HEIC files are sent unchanged.

temp.title: Temporary files
temp.errorInteger: Enter a whole number of GB, 0 or more.

ffmpeg.title: ffmpeg
ffmpeg.hint: A folder with ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe, directly or in bin.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.hint: squeezegram keeps a journal of what it does, for 7 days at most, to help find the cause of a problem. It never contains your phone number, codes, passwords, e-mail address or captions.
diagnostics.exportHint: Saves a .zip file with the recent journal, the versions in use and the latest error codes. Folders are removed, file names are replaced by neutral markers (file-1, file-2…) and chats are masked. Nothing is sent anywhere: you choose whether to share it.

kind.installer: Installed with the installer: updates download and install from here.
kind.portable: Portable build: a new version is announced but never installed for you. Download it and replace this folder.

automatic.label: Check automatically
automatic.hint: Looks for a new version on GitHub when the app starts, at most once a day. Only a standard web request is sent: no identifier, no Windows version, no usage data.

background.title: Background
background.locked: Included with squeezegram Premium: keep running in the notification area and start hidden with Windows. Until then, closing the window quits the app, and Start with Windows opens the window.

close.label: When I close the window
close.hint: While it keeps running, the queue and the watched folders go on working. Right-click the icon in the notification area to pause the queue or quit.
close.tray: Keep running in the notification area

autostart.label: Start with Windows
autostart.hint: squeezegram starts when you sign in to Windows. With Premium it stays hidden in the notification area; without it, its window shows. This applies right away; there is nothing to save.
autostart.inactive: Starting hidden needs Premium. The startup entry is still there, so Windows starts squeezegram with its window showing. Turn this off to remove the entry.

groupRisk.title: Sending to groups and channels
groupRisk.scope: This notice never applies to Saved Messages or private chats.
groupRisk.pending: It will be shown once, before your first send to a group or channel.

banner.title: Update available (version {{version}})
banner.needsKey: Version {{version}} is available. Your license covers squeezegram up to {{major}}.x; version {{newMajor}}.x needs a new license.
banner.needsKeyNote: You can keep using this version. The free features of the new version stay free if you install it yourself.
banner.portableHint: This is the portable build: download the new zip and replace this folder.
banner.queueRunning: Pause the queue first: squeezegram closes to install the update.
banner.installing: Installing: squeezegram will close and restart.

recovery.title: Something went wrong
recovery.body: This screen hit an unexpected error. The details were written to the journal; you can export them from Settings, Diagnostics.

connection.title: Telegram connection
connection.testTransport: Test transport: sign-in and sending are simulated, nothing reaches Telegram.
connection.closed: Telegram is not available in this build, so signing in is not possible.
connection.stopped: Telegram is stopped. Restart squeezegram to connect again.

startFailed.title: Telegram couldn't start
startFailed.resetHint: The Telegram session saved on this computer can't be opened. This happens after a Windows password reset, a profile migration, or when squeezegram is copied to another Windows account. Resetting the local session fixes it.
startFailed.resetBody: The Telegram session saved on this computer is deleted and Telegram starts again. You will have to sign in again. Your queue, history and settings are kept.
startFailed.otherHint: Check the proxy and the Telegram settings, then restart squeezegram.

connection.loadError: The sign-in state couldn't be read.

phone.title: Sign in with your phone number
phone.label: Phone number
phone.hint: With the country code, for example +33 6 12 34 56 78.

qr.title: Scan this code with Telegram on your phone
qr.body: Open Telegram, then Settings, Devices, Link Desktop Device. The code renews on its own.

code.title: Enter the login code
code.label: Code
code.hint: Telegram sent it to your other devices or by SMS.
code.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {{duration}}.

email.title: Enter your e-mail address
email.label: E-mail address
email.hint: Telegram uses it to secure your sign-in.

emailCode.title: Enter the code sent to your e-mail
emailCode.label: E-mail code

other.title: Telegram needs another step
other.body: This step ({{step}}) can't be done in squeezegram. Finish it in the official Telegram app, then come back.

ready.title: Signed in
ready.logoutBody: The local session is deleted. You will have to sign in again to send files.

destinations.renameHint: Only shown in squeezegram. Leave empty to use the Telegram name.

interval.label: Minimum time between two sends (minutes)
interval.hint: Empty or 0: no minimum. Files for this chat wait until this much time has passed since the last one sent there; files for other chats go meanwhile.
interval.error: Enter a whole number of minutes, from 0 to 10080 (one week).
interval.summary: At least {{duration}} between two sends to this chat.

topics.show: (press right arrow to show the topics)

destinations.telegramHint: These chats are not in your lists.
destinations.unnamedHint: Chats without a name, often deleted accounts.

codec.hevcWarning: HEVC files may not play inline in every Telegram app. Choose H.264 if the people you send to use older apps.

unavailable.no_hevc_encoder: HEVC is unavailable: none of the graphics card encoders (NVENC, Quick Sync, AMF) of the ffmpeg in use works for HEVC on this computer. Choose an ffmpeg that has one in Settings.
unavailable.ffmpeg_unavailable: HEVC cannot be checked because ffmpeg is not available.

quit.title: Quit squeezegram?
quit.body: A file is being compressed or sent. If you quit now, it is interrupted. A file that was being sent is marked Unconfirmed, so you can check next time whether it arrived.

groupRisk.title: Before you send to a group or channel
groupRisk.intro: Sending files again and again to groups or channels where you don't have the right permissions can get your Telegram account restricted.

practice.title: Good practice
practice.permissions: Only send to groups and channels where you are allowed to post.
practice.slowMode: Respect slow mode and the pauses between sends; don't shorten them to go faster.
practice.spam: Don't spam: avoid sending large batches of files to the same group.

groupRisk.promise: squeezegram follows Telegram's rules and has no workaround for its limits: it can't promise your account won't be restricted.
